name.text: W06_Q17: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following details correctly describe Isaac's birth as recorded in Genesis 21? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Isaac was born at the appointed time when Abraham was 100 years old, and he was circumcised on the eighth day (Genesis 21:1-5). Isaac was a single child, not a twin.

name.text: W06_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: In which ways does the account of Isaac on Mount Moriah prefigure Jesus Christ? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Isaac prefigures Christ as the beloved only son, bearing the wood of the sacrifice, and having a substitutionary ram die in his place. Isaac submitted willingly without violence.

name.text: W06_Q19: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each Hebrew or theological term with its proper biblical significance:

generalfeedback.text: Isaac means laughter; Moriah was the mountain; Jehovah Jireh means God will provide; and the ram was the substitutionary offering.
